post.topic: Automated Catering Inquiry Handling for Restaurants
post.headline: Never Miss a *Catering Inquiry* During Peak Rush
post.subline: Instantly collect event details, guest counts, and contact info without pulling staff away from customers.
post.caption:
When your restaurant is packed during Friday dinner rush, who is answering catering inquiries?

High-value event requests sit in DMs or email inboxes for hours.
By the time your staff reply, the client has already booked another venue.

AI automation fixes this seamlessly.
An automated flow captures the event date, guest count, budget, and dietary preferences 24/7, then alerts your manager instantly.

Today's tip: Set up an automated DM keyword like 'CATERING' that sends an instant intake form to capture event leads immediately.

Save this post for later and send it to a restaurant owner who wants to grow event revenue.

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call.
post.insight_note: Restaurants lose thousands in event revenue by delaying responses to high-ticket catering inquiries during peak service hours.
